features.name: Main menu and rules explanation
steps: Launch the app
View Play / Settings / How to Play
Enter How to Play
Read the complete rules
Back returns to the home page
features.expected: The main menu must include Play, Settings, and How to Play entries; How to Play must display the complete rules; Back returns to the main menu without affecting other states.

features.name: Basic game parameter configuration
steps: Tap Play
Adjust Width, Height, Win condition, and Number of players
Tap Start
Check the generated board
features.expected: The number of rows and columns generated by Start must match the Width and Height configuration; the win condition and player count are applied correctly; illegal parameters should be limited or rejected rather than crashing.

features.name: Basic tic-tac-toe moves and turns
steps: Configure the simplest board and 2 players
Player 1 taps an empty cell
Player 2 taps another empty cell
Play several rounds in succession
features.expected: After a move that cell shows the current player's piece and the state persists; turns strictly rotate Player 1 → 2 → 1; a played cell cannot be overwritten or played again.

features.name: Win, loss, and draw detection on a normal board
steps: Create an ordinary board
Let a player satisfy the win condition horizontally, vertically, or diagonally
Verify it ends immediately; start another game, fill the board with no one satisfying the condition
features.expected: When a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal run satisfies the win condition the win is decided immediately and the board locked; when the board is full with no one satisfying the condition it is a draw; no further moves are allowed after the game ends.

features.name: Ultimate first-move free placement and next-board routing
steps: Start an Ultimate game
The first player plays any cell on any small board
Based on that cell's relative position in the small board, verify that the next player may only play on the small board at the corresponding position
features.expected: The first move is unrestricted; after it the next player may only play on the small board corresponding to that cell's relative position; the other small boards must be shown as inoperable.

features.name: Continuous routing and legal-area updates
steps: Player A plays and sends B to the specified small board
B plays at different positions on that board
Check that C/the next player is sent to the new target board
Play several rounds in succession
features.expected: After each move the legal areas update according to the played cell's relative position in the small board; only the target small board is operable; after several rounds the routing and operable areas stay consistent.

features.name: Win a local small board
steps: Let a player satisfy the local win condition within one small board
Check that the small board converts to the "occupied by that player" state
Try to play in another unfinished small board
features.expected: After satisfying the local win condition the small board must convert to that player's occupied state; an occupied small board can no longer be played; the big board shows the corresponding occupation marker.

features.name: Free choice when sent to a finished board
steps: First let one small board be won or filled
Then make a move so that the next player would originally be sent to this already-finished small board
After a size preset or custom change the output is recomputed in real time; the file size changes in sync.
features.expected: When the target small board has been won or filled, the next player may play on any unfinished small board; forcing a move on a finished board or making the game unable to continue is not allowed.

features.name: Ultimate global win detection
steps: Play continuously
Let the same player win several small boards satisfying the win condition
Form a horizontal/vertical/diagonal occupation run on the big board
Verify the game ends
features.expected: When the same player forms a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal run satisfying the win condition on the big board the game ends immediately; it must not be called early when no line is formed.

features.name: Multi-player 2–4 player rotation
steps: Set 2 players and play several moves
Recreate 3-player and 4-player games
Verify Player 1 respectively
… the order and each player's piece colors
A player wins a small board
features.expected: The rotation order is correct for each player count; each player's piece color matches the configuration; the occupation marker after winning a small board uses that player's color.

features.name: Player color / RGB configuration
steps: Settings
Change the three color values of each of Players 1–4
Save
Start a game with the corresponding player count
Check the piece and big-board occupation-marker colors
features.expected: After saving, the color configuration takes effect and persists; after starting the game the pieces and the big-board occupation markers use the corresponding RGB colors.

features.name: Custom board size
steps: Set different Width / Height values respectively
Start
Check the board's row/column counts, tap mapping, boundaries, and layout
Complete Ultimate game
features.expected: The generated board's rows and columns must match Width and Height; taps map to the correct cells; boundary cells can be played normally; the layout is not misaligned by size changes.

features.name: Custom win condition
steps: Set the win condition to different values on a larger board
Create a game
First form a run of marks shorter than the required length
Then fill it up to the specified length
features.expected: A run shorter than the win condition must not be judged a win; the win is only decided once the specified length is reached; the detection must use the configured value rather than a hard-coded one.

features.name: Returning and creating a new game during a game
steps: Start a game and play several moves
Back
Play again
Change the parameter
Start
features.expected: After Back the old game state no longer applies; after playing again and changing parameters, Start generates a new board matching the configuration; the old game must not pollute the new one.

features.name: Complex board-state rendering
steps: Play until several small boards are partly completed and partly won by X/O players
Observe the large player symbol, the local small pieces, the gray/white legal areas, and the current operable area

features.name: The complete optimization flow (import / Resize / Palette / encode / compare / download) is correct at every step; the final download succeeds.
steps: Start from an empty board
Continuously determine legal moves according to the rules
Win several local boards
Handle being sent to an already-completed board
Finally win the global board or form a draw
features.expected: The legal moves, routing, local wins, free choice, and global win detection must be consistent throughout the game; illegal moves or routing errors must not occur; after the game ends the board keeps its final state.
